skill_cards.if_condition: When a host responds to TCP 80/443 with identifiable web content
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto against the target to enumerate known vulnerabilities and default credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH port 22 is detected open during scanning
skill_cards.then_action: Launch nmap ssh-enum-users and ssh-brute scripts to identify weak credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When a web application exposes login functionality
skill_cards.then_action: Execute wfuzz with wordlist to discover hidden endpoints and credentials
